findings.reason: the node would either certify a locus that violates the ruling or, reading the instrument, invert the two spellings on 44 live names, and the fix is to state the ruled suffix per locus and plant a uniformly mis-spelled locus as the control.
findings.text: the endpoint "one suffix per DD locus" fixes only that names agree, never which spelling they must agree on, so a locus whose names are unanimously spelled `_at_separatrix` has one suffix and passes although the lead's 2026-11-07 ruling and the committed instrument both call it out of line — and the read-back a node would re-run carries `suffix_by_locus.separatrix_average.proposed_locator = "_flux_surface_averaged_at_plasma_boundary"` (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-consistency/scc-separatrix-remainder.json`), the trailing order the section's own ruling rules against (`flux_surface_averaged_X_at_plasma_boundary`), so following the instrument would rename the 44 live average-locus names into the wrong order; the planted control exercises only the two-suffix case, so the gate cannot see either failure

findings.reason: a node would route a dead tombstone chain to the lead and leave the two live names its endpoint actually fails on unassigned, which are also the pair the lead ruled on 2026-11-12 toward that same target spelling.
findings.text: the prose's residual list ("the exact boundary spelling of the tritium velocity, and the two cases whose tombstone ends on a different live concept, starting with `electron_temperature_at_separatrix` to `thermal_electron_temperature_at_plasma_boundary`") does not match the read-back it says has landed: `scc-separatrix-reclaim.json` `census` reads population 111, conforming 109 and exactly 2 out of line, both on `summary/local/separatrix_average/n_i/deuterium_tritium/value` and both targeting `flux_surface_averaged_deuterium_tritium_density_at_plasma_boundary`; the two names the prose names are superseded tombstones carrying no live suffix (`scc-separatrix-remainder.json`: `thermal_electron_temperature_at_plasma_boundary` → `refined_into: ["electron_temperature_at_separatrix"]`, which is itself `refined_into: []`), and `toroidal_tritium_velocity_at_plasma_boundary` is not out of line

findings.reason: without the ordering a node can run §6 beside the rewrite, certify one suffix per locus, and have the certification undone by renames §3's final census does not re-check for this cohort.
findings.text: §6 declares no wait on `sn-definitions-by-construction#s6`, though §2 of this same plan states that section "rewrites the live catalog" and that "a name that its name-against-definition dispositions rename" leaves still-standing rows, and §2 therefore re-reads after §6 lands; §6's endpoint is a property of that same live catalog and a rename landing after it reintroduces the divergence its read-back certified
